vocabulary.meaning_en: to have just enough money to live, with nothing extra
vocabulary.example: I don't earn much, but I'm getting by.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to live with almost not enough money; it feels hard
vocabulary.note_en: Harder and more negative than get by.
vocabulary.example: After he lost his job, the family scraped by.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to save money over a long time for something big
vocabulary.example: I'm saving up for a new car.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to keep some money for a short time for something specific
the time when you stop working forever because of age
vocabulary.example: They are saving up for retirement.
I had to fork over $50 for a parking ticket.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay money when you don't want to
vocabulary.example: He had to cough up $400 for a new TV.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to spend a lot of money, unwillingly
vocabulary.example: We shelled out a lot for the repairs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take a small amount from your savings once
vocabulary.note_en: Like a quick dip in a pool.
vocabulary.example: My car broke down, so I dipped into my savings.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start using your savings again and again until they disappear
vocabulary.example: The rent is so high that I had to break into my savings.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to return money you borrowed (not always all of it yet)
vocabulary.example: I'm paying back my loan $100 a week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay all of a debt so it is finished
vocabulary.example: I finally paid off my credit card.
He has a big debt to the bank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money you have kept and not spent
vocabulary.example: She keeps her savings in the bank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to one side; a short comment off the main topic
vocabulary.example: Let me make a quick aside.

fine_lines.title: get by vs scrape by
fine_lines.explanation_ar: get by: لديك ما يكفي للأساسيات فقط، وهي إيجابية نسبيًا. scrape by: لديك أقل من الكافي تقريبًا وكل يوم صعب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Get by: enough for the basics; fairly positive. Scrape by: almost not enough; every day is hard.

examples.sentence: We get by on one salary.
Students often scrape by at the end of the month.

fine_lines.title: save up vs put aside
fine_lines.explanation_ar: save up: ادّخار لفترة طويلة لشيء كبير. put aside: تخصيص مبلغ صغير لفترة قصيرة لشيء محدد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Save up: long time, big purchase. Put aside: short time, something specific.

examples.sentence: They saved up for five years to buy a house.
I put aside $10 for the bus this week.

fine_lines.title: dip into vs break into
fine_lines.explanation_ar: dip into: تأخذ مبلغًا صغيرًا مرة واحدة. break into: تبدأ باستنزاف المدّخرات مرارًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Dip into: take a little once. Break into: keep taking until the savings go down a lot.

examples.sentence: I dipped into my savings for a new phone.
Without a job, he had to break into his savings.

fine_lines.title: pay back vs pay off
fine_lines.explanation_ar: pay back: تُعيد المال تدريجيًا وقد لا تكون انتهيت. pay off: سدّدت الدين كاملًا وانتهى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Pay back: return money, maybe not finished. Pay off: the whole debt is finished.

examples.sentence: I'm paying back my brother bit by bit.
We paid off the car loan last month.

expressions.meaning_en: I have enough, but nothing extra.
expressions.example: How's the new job? - Not great pay, but I'm getting by.

expressions.meaning_en: I'm saving money for something big.
expressions.example: I'm saving up for a trip to Mecca.

expressions.meaning_en: I had to pay (and I didn't want to).
expressions.example: I had to cough up $100 to fix my phone.

expressions.phrase: I had to dip into my savings.
expressions.meaning_en: I took a little from my savings.
expressions.example: The washing machine broke, so I had to dip into my savings.
Good news: I paid off my debt!

questions.question: "Mr. E's TV stopped working, and he had to ___ $400 for a new one." (pay unwillingly)
questions.explanation_en: Cough up = pay when you don't want to.

questions.question: "He had been ___ for a new car." (long time, big purchase)
questions.explanation_ar: save up لشيء كبير ولمدة طويلة.
questions.explanation_en: Save up = long-term saving for something big.

questions.question: "He had to ___ his savings once to buy the TV." (take a little)
questions.explanation_ar: dip into = يأخذ قليلًا مرة واحدة.
questions.explanation_en: Dip into = take a little once.

questions.question: "Next week he had to ___ on $20 a day." (enough, nothing extra)
"I finally ___ my credit card. I owe nothing now."
questions.explanation_en: Pay off = pay all of it.

questions.question: "Put aside $20 for dinner" means:
choices: keep $20 for a short time for dinner
questions.explanation_ar: put aside = تخصيص مبلغ لغرض قريب.
questions.explanation_en: Keep it for a specific short-term use.

questions.question: "Without a job, I had to keep taking money from my savings." I had to ___ my savings.
"We had to ___ a lot of money for the car repair." (spend unwillingly)
